items.source: type - a Consumer used to build the type
items.translation: type - 用于构建类型的 Consumer

items.source: featureName - the name of the feature to associate with the generated class
items.translation: featureName - 要与生成的类关联的功能名称

items.source: Add a new generated class for the specified featureName targeting the specified component.
items.translation: 为指定的 `featureName` 添加一个针对指定 `component` 的新生成类。

items.source: an existing or newly generated class

Get or add a generated class for the specified featureName targeting the specified component. If this method has previously been called with the given featureName/target the existing class will be returned, otherwise a new class will be generated, otherwise a new class will be generated.
items.translation: 获取或为指定的 `featureName`》针对指定的 `component`》添加生成的类。如果此前已使用给定的 `featureName`/`target` 调用过此方法，则返回现有类；否则将生成一个新类。

items.source:
This class is stateful, so the same instance should be used for all class
generation.
items.translation: 该类是有状态的，因此应使用同一实例进行所有类的生成。

items.source: Get or add a generated class for the specified featureName targeting the specified component.
items.translation: 获取或为指定的 `featureName` 添加生成的类，该目标指向指定的 `component`。

items.source: Get or add a generated class for the specified featureName and no particular component. If this method has previously been called with the given featureName the existing class will be returned, otherwise a new class will be generated.
items.translation: 获取或为指定的 `featureName` 添加一个生成的类，且不针对特定组件。如果此前已使用给定的 `featureName` 调用过此方法，则返回现有类；否则将生成一个新类。

items.source: Add a new generated class for the specified featureName and no particular component.
items.translation: 为指定的featureName添加一个新的生成类，且不针对特定组件。

items.source: Get or add a generated class for the specified featureName and no particular component.
